This is an actual framework API response for List Cleaner’s own user and caller identity. The module may exempt its manager app from filtering. It does not prove the result another app or the final system picker receives.
Live candidates for the example Intent used by the System panel button. MIME type, URL and caller identity can affect the list.

Live declared providers; the system file/photo picker may use a separate internal list.
Live registered services. The final Settings, Role, VPN or NFC list is privileged and may differ.
Available shortcut configuration activities. This is not the full dynamic, pinned or direct-share shortcut list.
Available widget providers. Launchers may apply additional rules before showing them.
Services declaring the Quick Settings Tile action. This is not a direct SystemUI tile-editor query.
The chosen Android user differs from the app’s own user. A normal app cannot reliably query the other user’s live interface; switch to that profile to test. No personal-space result is substituted.
Android exposes no general public API to read the final contents of this system UI. The app will not substitute its saved or observed candidates.
Android denied access to this system interface.
The system API query failed. No cached candidate list is substituted.
The system UI can add direct-share suggestions, role eligibility, user-specific entries and OEM filtering. These public API entries are NOT its final list.
These are package candidates from Android queries, not the final eligible RoleController list. Selection may differ.

A result is reported as enabled only if a public Android enabled-service API confirms it. PackageManager matches, installed widgets, roles, service declarations and DocumentsUI/PhotoPicker providers are NOT the final displayed list. Profiles and OEM UIs can differ.
